releases.name: v0.17.2 — OpenCode v2.4.1 Alignment, Stream Stop Verification & Opt-in Transcript Notices
releases.body:
Aligns opencode-guardian with OpenCode v2.4.1 and ships stream stop verification, telemetry display fix, and opt-in chat transcript notices:
- Upgraded devDependencies to @opencode/plugin ^2.4.1 and @opentui/core + @opentui/solid ^0.9.9 (keeping peerDependencies >=2.3.0 / >=0.8.4 backward-compatible).
- Reconciled canonical background job keys (jobID -> shellID -> childSessionID -> kind:path -> id) between experimental.idle and experimental.job.updated across all 5 v2.4.x job kinds.
- Added TUI plugin.updated & config.updated non-blocking startup / hot-reload refresh listeners and cleanup of dismissedInterventionSignatures.
- Added immediate abort guard inside eventLoop (v2.4.1 #65441) and lastTranscriptNotice cleanup on delete/move/dispose.
- Added host-verified stream stops (stream-interrupt-verified / stream-interrupt-ineffective) and streamStops / streamVerified / streamIneffective counters across TUI sidebar, /guardian-status, and opencode-guardian-status.
- Fixed out-of-process telemetry default reporting (violations instead of all) in TUI, /guardian-status, and opencode-guardian-status.
- Added opt-in model-invisible chat transcript notices (notifications.transcript: true).
- Verified with 827/827 tests, 18/18 sandbox scenarios, 10/10 live OpenCode v2.4.1 + Bun 1.4.4 acceptance checks, and 0 prod audit vulnerabilities.

releases.name: v0.17.1 — OpenCode v2.4.0 Compatibility
releases.body:
Aligns opencode-guardian with OpenCode v2.4.0:
- Updated devDependencies to @opencode/plugin ^2.4.0 and @opentui/core + @opentui/solid ^0.9.7 (matching @opencode/plugin@2.4.0's >=0.9.4 floor while preserving peerDependencies compatibility).
- Handled backgrounded Code Mode execute jobs (metadata.jobID, Execution moved to the background, type: synthetic source: codemode completions) in hasUnfinishedBackgroundTool and statusFromPart.
- Extracted nested metadata.toolCalls from top-level dotted Code Mode calls (tools.ns.fn) in normalizeV2AssistantParts.
- Tracked per-session active background jobs from experimental.idle (including video/codemode) and cleared backgroundSessions locks on experimental.job.updated (completed/error/cancelled).
- Classified ses_aut_* automation child run sessions as subagents and invalidated capability caches on plugin.updated + teardown for v2.4.0 hot-reload.
- Verified with 815/815 unit & regression tests, 18/18 sandbox scenarios, and 10/10 live OpenCode v2.4.0 + Bun 1.4.4 acceptance checks.

releases.name: v0.17.0 — Critical Preflight Mode, Global Config Security Floor & In-Memory Telemetry Counters
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.17.0

- **Frictionless `"critical"` vs `"strict"` Preflight Protection Modes (`src/preflight.ts`, `src/types.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/commands.ts`):**
  - Added `preflight.mode?: "critical" | "strict"` (`"strict"` remains the default when `preflight.enabled: true` for full backward compatibility).
  - **`"critical"` Mode (`{ "preflight": { "enabled": true, "mode": "critical" } }`):** Blocks catastrophic destructive shell operations (`rm -rf`, `git reset --hard`, `git push --force`, `git clean -f`, `mkfs`, fork bombs, `DROP DATABASE`, `terraform destroy`, `kubectl delete ns`, `docker system prune -a`, `npm unpublish`, `gh repo delete`, `find -delete`), opaque decoded shell execution (`base64 -d | sh`, `powershell -enc`), dynamic command names, hardcoded secrets and truncation placeholders in file writes, and hallucinated/malformed npm packages — while allowing everyday developer actions (`rm <single-file>`, `printenv`/`env`/`docker inspect`, and short/WIP git commit messages).
- **Global-to-Project Config Hierarchy & Untrusted Repo Downgrade Protection (`src/engine.ts`, `src/types.ts`, `src/commands.ts`):**
  - Updated `loadConfig(directory)` to read and merge both the global configuration (`~/.config/opencode/opencode-guardian.json`, `$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode`) and the project configuration (`<project>/opencode-guardian.json` or `.opencode/opencode-guardian.json`) so project configs inherit global settings.
  - Added `allowProjectOverrides?: boolean` to `GuardConfig`: when `"allowProjectOverrides": false` is set in the global configuration, untrusted project repositories cannot disable Guardian (`enabled: false`), disable `preflight.enabled`, downgrade `preflight.mode` from `"strict"` to `"critical"`, disable `secrets.enabled`, reduce remediation/iteration budgets, or weaken rule severities (`error` → `warn`/`off`, `warn` → `off`).
- **In-Memory Live Telemetry Counters & `violations` Mode Transparency (`src/telemetry.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `scripts/guardian-status.mjs`, `src/index.ts`):**
  - Tracked per-project in-memory inspection (`inspectedSkippedDisk`) and secret redaction (`recordGuardianRedaction` / `status.redacted`) counters even when `telemetry.level === "violations"` skips disk writes for benign `preflight-allowed` and `post-inspected` events.
  - Updated `/guardian-status` and `opencode-guardian-status` to display `Telemetry mode: violations (clean turns omit disk I/O)` and `Secret redactions (in-memory)`.
- **Verification:** **810 / 810** unit & regression tests passing, **18 / 18** sandbox scenarios, **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.3.2` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, Oxlint 0 warnings / 0 errors across 113 files.

releases.name: v0.16.3 — XDG_STATE_HOME Compliance & Verification Alignment
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.16.3

- **XDG State Directory Compliance (`src/telemetry.ts`):**
  - Updated `guardianStateDirectory` to honor an absolute `XDG_STATE_HOME` path (when `OPENCODE_GUARDIAN_STATE_DIR` and `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` are unset), falling back to `~/.local/state/opencode-guardian` when `XDG_STATE_HOME` is unset or relative per the XDG Base Directory Specification.
- **Test & Verification Alignment:**
  - Added `XDG_STATE_HOME` resolution coverage in `tests/project-scope-and-state-isolation.test.mjs` and standardized the deep-debug regression suite name to `tests/v0162-deep-debug.test.mjs`.

**Verification:** 807 / 807 unit & regression tests, 18 / 18 sandbox scenarios, 10 / 10 live OpenCode `v2.3.2` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, strict TypeScript, and Oxlint (0 warnings / 0 errors across 113 files).

releases.name: v0.16.2 — V2 Mesh/Idle Hardening, TUI Polling Fix & Preflight Precision
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.16.2

- **TUI Banner Lifecycle & Polling Precision (`src/tui.tsx`):** Preserved local TTL expiration and click-to-dismiss state across 500ms `guardian.interventions.current` RPC polling so expired or dismissed banners are never resurrected or have their TTL reset.
- **V2 Mesh, Idle & Remediation Lifecycle Hardening (`src/index.ts`, `src/bridge.ts`, `src/engine.ts`):**
  - Prevented paired V2 idle events (`session.status: idle` + `session.idle`) from wiping active remediation leases or mesh interventions.
  - Ensured `remediationStatus: "verified"` followed by a new post-warning on the same turn still clears cleanly on the next human prompt.
  - Kept `question_presented` handoffs waiting for a real user reply without falling through to re-block, consumed the handoff on user reply, and ignored trusted mesh messages during `question_presented`.
  - Filtered lazy skill tags and trusted mesh messages out of task contract extraction and destructive command authorization.
  - Cleared preflight-blocked interventions on allowed follow-up tools or RPC clear, preserved `[TASK OUTCOME]` in subagent `execute.after`, and avoided caching unknown agent capabilities.
- **V2 Hooks, Shell Creation & Code Mode Visibility (`src/index.ts`):**
  - Updated `shell.hook("create.before")` to resolve `env.OPENCODE_SESSION_ID` and prevent scope bypass via `cwd: "/tmp"`.
  - Ignored descendant-owned background jobs in `experimental.idle`, detected `v2.3.1` timed-out-to-background shells in `hasUnfinishedBackgroundTool`, preserved `callID`, `output`, `error`, and non-zero `exitCode` in Code Mode `execute` nested `toolCalls`, and preferred `meta.command` over `description` for synthetic shell normalization.
- **Preflight, Sanitizer & Rule Precision:**
  - Fixed `splitShellStages` (`2>&1` redirections), blocked `git 2>&1 reset --hard`, PowerShell `-ec`, and `true && printenv` in `evaluatePreflight`.
  - Allowed deletion-only patches and per-file markdown exemptions in `apply_patch`, and prevented Rust lifetimes from masking stubs/truncation.
  - Handled circular references, preserved `Error` subclasses & `Date` instances, protected valid mesh tokens, and redacted forged mesh tokens in JSON strings in `sanitizeObject` / `sanitizeMessages`.
  - Fixed edit-resolution false positives, multi-stage destructive authorization, research-only constraint false positives, multi-file secret reporting, Go `t.SkipNow()`, `no-evasion` subsequent matches, and `guardianCommandReport("rules")` severity resolution.

**Verification:** 806 / 806 unit & regression tests, 18 / 18 sandbox scenarios, 10 / 10 live OpenCode `v2.3.2` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, strict TypeScript, and Oxlint (0 warnings / 0 errors across 113 files).
